violated_contract: Android app-review visibility must reflect a genuinely completed Google Play rollout. A production release committed with changesNotSentForReview=true is still held for review even if its track status is completed, and an unavailable submission token can prevent the hide from being recorded; neither condition may silently clear or omit the review hide.
canonical_prevention: While Play changes are held, write a draft production release so completed remains the live signal. Include submission_token_unavailable in the paging rule and document the Secret Manager and Codemagic rotation checks. Contract tests cover the held draft and completed rollout reconciliation, and assert that the token-unavailable reason is paged.
